provenance.purpose: Development-only operational scenario reachability; excluded from frozen80 quality and latency aggregates
provenance.source_generation: 48 instrument/bay directory-certificate pairs; modular bijective registry mapping; 64 independent station records. Formula and literal bytes frozen here. No provider or retrieval feedback used. Ops-v2 adds eight deterministic, wholly synthetic calibration logs: 144 structured readings per log, explicit instrument calibration, qualified accepted values and end-of-log rejection/correction. No model or ranking feedback used.

schedule.order: For repetition 1, preservation then combined; repetition 2 reverse; repetition 3 original. Workloads run in listed order in every arm. Separate processes per mode/profile; concurrency1. Record all runs, never stop after success.
schedule.cache_state: Record measured state; do not claim cold/warm from a label. No shared-user cache flush.
